brand.name: Global Locksmiths Pty Ltd
brand.audience: Our ideal customers span a broad range of situations and needs. We serve residential homeowners who need lock installations, repairs, rekeying after moving into a new home, or emergency lockout assistance. We also work with commercial property owners and businesses — including office and corporate buildings, retail shops, supermarkets and shopping centres, medical centres and aged care facilities, schools and TAFE centres, and government buildings. Additionally, we work with architects, builders and trades professionals. Our customers are typically Melbourne and Geelong residents and businesses who value security, reliability, and quality workmanship, and who want a licensed, insured, and accredited locksmith they can trust.

business_goals: To help homes and businesses achieve complete security and peace of mind through quality locksmith solutions, outstanding service, and unparalleled workmanship.
compliance_restrictions: We comply with the standards set by the Master Locksmiths Association of Australasia and the Australian New Zealand Locksmiths Association. All our locksmiths are fully licensed and insured in Victoria, and our practices and workmanship are maintained in line with ever-changing industry standards within the locksmith trade.
customer_process: The customer contacts us via phone on 1300 333 565 or through our online enquiry form to discuss their service needs — whether it's a lockout, key cutting, rekeying, or a full installation.
We provide a clear, no-obligation quote based on the requested service, and the customer confirms and books the job.
A qualified locksmith arrives at the scheduled time to complete the job professionally, ensuring high standards of security and quality.
Once the job is finished, the customer inspects the work, payment is processed, and any post-service support or follow-up is provided if needed.
success_stories: One of our most memorable success stories involves a client who had trouble with their electronic lock at their office — it simply wasn't opening properly and was causing significant disruption to their business operations. Our technician attended the site, diagnosed the fault, and was able to repair the electronic lock on the spot without needing a full replacement. Not only did we resolve the issue efficiently, but our technician also took the time to show the client how to avoid the same problem in the future. The outcome was a fully functioning lock, a more informed client, and a positive review praising our good service and reasonable pricing.

insurance: All work is fully insured. Every job comes with a standard 12-month warranty on workmanship and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. We provide free, no-obligation quotes before any work begins, no pressure, no hidden charges, no surprises. When you choose Global Locksmiths, you're choosing a locksmith who is licensed, insured, independently accredited, and accountable for every job they complete.
guarantees: Standard 12-Month Warranty — we guarantee quality on all work completed, giving customers peace of mind that our workmanship is backed for a full year.
100% Satisfaction Guarantee — we stand by our work and are committed to ensuring our customers' complete satisfaction.
No-Obligation Free Quote — we offer a free, no-obligation quote so customers can understand costs upfront with no pressure.
Licensed & Insured assurance — all our locksmiths are fully licensed, insured, and accredited, providing customers with confidence in the safety and legality of our services.
why_started: Global Locksmiths is led by Shane Tipping, a fully qualified and licensed Master Locksmith with more than 25 years of hands-on experience supporting homes and businesses across Melbourne and Geelong. Shane built the business from the ground up, originally operating as Newmans Locksmiths before rebranding to Global Locksmiths and growing it into one of Melbourne's most trusted mobile locksmith services. With decades of practical experience across Melbourne's northern, western, southern and eastern suburbs, as well as Geelong, Shane brings real-world knowledge, technical skill and trusted local service to every job.
